examples.arabic: لكن توقعاته كانت خاطئة تماماً، ففي منتصف الليل، استيقظ الأولاد على صوت الرعد الرهيب والبرق الذي أضاء الغرفة.
examples.english: But his predictions were completely wrong, for in the middle of the night, the children woke up to the sound of terrible thunder and lightning that lit up the room.
examples.transliteration: Laken tawqqa'at-u kanat khati'a tamaman, fa-fi muntasaf al-layl, istayqaz al-awlad 'ala sawt ar-ra'd ar-raheeb wal-barq alladhi ada'a al-ghurfa.

examples.arabic: أختي كانت واقفة عند الشباك، عم تراقب البرق بيضوي السما والرعد بيرجف أضراسها من قوة صوته.
examples.english: My sister was standing at the window, watching the lightning illuminate the sky and the thunder shaking her teeth from the strength of its sound.
examples.transliteration: okhti kanat waqfe 'and esh-shubbaak, 'am traaqib el-barq byidwi es-sama w er-ra'd byirjef adraasha min quwwet sawto.

examples.arabic: فجاة شفت برق من الشباك وعرفت انو الطقس صار عاصف
examples.english: Suddenly I saw lightning from the window and I knew that the weather became windy.
examples.transliteration: Fajaah shefet barq men el shubbak w arafet inno el taqes sar aasef

examples.arabic: ماما شو هاد الصوت العالي وهاد الضو اللي بيطلع فجأة سأل ليث وهو بيأشر على الرعد والبرق
examples.english: "Mama what is this loud sound and this light that appears suddenly" Laith asked pointing at the thunder and lightning.
examples.transliteration: "Mama shoo had es-sowt el aali w had ed-daww illi bitla' faj'a" sa'al Laith w howe bya'asher ala er-ra'ed w el barq.

examples.arabic: صوت صاحبتي كان واضح ودافي رغم الرعد والبرق يلي كانوا ماليين الجو
examples.english: My friend's voice was clear and warm despite the thunder and lightning filling the air.
examples.transliteration: Sawt sahbeti kaan wadeh w dafi raghm ir-ra'ed wil-barq yalli kaanu malliyeen il-jaw.
examples.storyTitle: A Call on a Stormy Day

examples.arabic: فجأة سمعت صوت برق كتير قوي وقطعت الكهربا والخط انقطع
examples.english: Suddenly I heard a very loud lightning sound, the electricity cut off, and the line disconnected.
examples.transliteration: Faj'atan same't sawt barq ktīr qawe w qata'at el kahraba w el khatt enqata'.
